## db98b701e5bb

**Status: reproduced override-contract defect.**

The generator advertises exact axes `palette_kind`, helpful `texture`, `anchor_corner`, and `asymmetry_force`, but the implementation never consumes them. Opposing valid values produced byte-identical grids on 120/120 same-seed comparisons per axis (40 sample indices in each of easy, medium, and hard); both variants passed `self_check`. A single unknown override is also silently accepted and ignored instead of rejected.

The normal reproducer input is lawful and its authoritative Racket output is valid, so this is an input-control/API defect rather than a label mismatch. The ignored controls make reported coverage misleading and prevent callers from obtaining the promised variation.

Evidence: `checks/audit/db98b701e5bb/contract-defect.json`, `input.json`, and supported authority run `racket.json`. Generator SHA-256 `db1e4220528e27a5618e2aa0f72776093d1170ad16787e3eab04ad94e9a487b5`; rule hash `da19a5612a17`. No audit-target files were changed.

Recommended follow-up: either implement each advertised control through keyed draws and add `observe_overrides`, or delete axes that are not meaningful; in both cases reject unknown keys before constructing `gen_ctx`.
